data.description: Hooks are the guardrail primitive: .agents/hooks.json with events pre_tool_execution / post_tool_execution, matcher regex on tool names, handler types command (runs in sandbox) and http; deny protocol returns {decision: deny, reason: ...} so the call is skipped and the reason is injected into model context. A rogue managed agent would show permissive matchers.
